notes.title: NEW YEAR'S UPDATE
notes.notes: Our latest update for C&T is here, and it's the perfect way to get into the holiday spirit with your friends! We've added a brand new Christmas map, complete with festive decorations. Plus, we've introduced a new girl skin for you to use to customize your character. And if that wasn't enough, we've also added an in-game item store, where you can purchase exclusive items to help you on your adventures. And the best part? This update is now completely free to all players. So don't wait - update your game and join in on the holiday fun with your friends now!
